title: Error Bars
summary: Means with ±1 SE error bars from a summary table, using geom_col() and geom_errorbar().
hints: In `summarise()`: `n = sum(!is.na(anxiety_post))`, `mean_post = mean(anxiety_post, na.rm = TRUE)`, `se = sd(anxiety_post, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n)`.
`ggplot(post_summary, aes(x = group, y = mean_post)) + geom_col()`: `geom_col()` uses the heights you computed.
`+ geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_post - se, ymax = mean_post + se), width = 0.2)`.
